description: Structured facts extracted from the BORME acts of a company, grouped by type (appointments, removals, capital changes, mergers, registered-office moves...) with person name and role when applicable, plus a `summary` with the count per type. Use it to answer "who was appointed / what changed" without reading raw act text.

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

name: borme_get_company_facts
